verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile sign-in and MFA credential app. User-defined automation rules that trigger actions on events fall outside this product category, much like asking a VPN tool to commit code. No evidence shows it ships any such rule engine: notification mirroring and admin-imposed location checks are fixed behaviors, not user-defined rules, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
